messages:
deploy-bot: staging rollout v7.0.0 -> 5% eu-west (change window 22:00-23:00 UTC)
mel: quick flag: p95 up ~100ms in eu-west, tiny sample but raising eyebrow
priya: looking at traces now, small cluster with tokenizer warnings and a couple 5xxs
sre-oncall: propose we quiet eu-west to 0% and soft-pin to previous stable while we triage. keep other regions moving
ops: +1 to soft-pin; suggest `route` to compat variant instead of hard rollback if available
mel: command suggestion: `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0` then `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant compat-6.9.8`
deploy-bot: executing traffic hold: `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: eu-west traffic set to 0% (op id: tx-3654)
deploy-bot: setting compat route: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant compat-6.9.8`
deploy-bot: eu-west routed to compat-6.9.8 (op id: rx-3654) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: running quick smoke (tokenizer sanity + kv warmup x50). If green: keep compat route and continue rollout elsewhere; if failing: escalate and prepare full pin to v6.9.8
priya: opening INF-9001 with traces + minimal repro, assigning to tokenizer team
release: drafting a one-line blurb for release notes/support: "EU percent routed to compat variant while we validate tokenizer changes."
mel: smoke passed basic checks; will monitor 10m telemetry before next steps
sre-oncall: marking eu-west stop/go: SOFT-STOP. other regions remain at 5% observe. change window ~40m left
ops: note: to revert route after fix: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west --variant v7.0.0` or remove compat with `redwoodctl route remove --region eu-west --route-id rx-3654`
priya: will update INF-9001 with findings and ETA for patch (~2-3h). will post here when PR merges
release: will coordinate customer comms only if we widen the pause. thanks all.
